attributes.board_name: Idaho Board of Medicine (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Practice-relevant CME (no category specified in the rule)
rules.alternatives: Instead of 40 hours: current board certification from ABMS, AOA or the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or full-time participation in an accredited residency or fellowship.
rules.audit_note: Attestation before renewal; the Board may require additional evidence of compliance.
rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. From April 1, 2026 DOPL is moving licenses to 2-year terms expiring on the licensee's birthdate (phased by birth year); CE requirements unchanged.
